gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have histologically confirmed glioblastoma (or gliosarcoma) at first or second recurrence after initial standard, control or experimental, therapy that includes at least radiation therapy (RT) and temozolomide (TMZ)

candidate_evidence.quote: To evaluate the anti-tumor activity of inducing hypothyroxinemic state by assessing progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS).
Patients receive methimazole orally (PO) daily and lomustine daily.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Inducing a Hypothyroxinemic State in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma or Gliosarcoma

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To evaluate the correlation of PFS and OS with thyroid hormone levels.
To evaluate the correlation of potential side effects with T3 levels or methimazole dose.

role_evidence.quote: This trial aims to see if giving a specific thyroid hormone, such as methimazole and liothyronine, is safe and could benefit cancer treatment.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: induction of a hypothyroxinemic state (low free T4)

role_evidence.quote: Patients receive liothyronine PO BID to maintain lower free T4 below lower limit of normal and TSH and free T3 in the normal range.
This trial aims to see if giving a specific thyroid hormone, such as methimazole and liothyronine, is safe and could benefit cancer treatment.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: induction of a hypothyroxinemic state (T3 replacement allowing low free T4)

flag.reason: Liothyronine may be viewed as hormone replacement (supportive) rather than an investigational antitumour agent; in Category 1 it is given only when TSH is above normal.

role_evidence.quote: Treatment with lomustine repeats every 6 weeks for up to 6 cycles or 12 months.

agents.drug_class_hint: nitrosourea alkylating agent, established therapy for recurrent GBM

coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 record (translational subset), coded in full. The investigational strategy is induction of hypothyroxinemia with methimazole and/or liothyronine (category-dependent: Category 1 methimazole +/- liothyronine; Categories 2-3 liothyronine replacing levothyroxine), on a lomustine background given to all patients; methimazole and liothyronine coded experimental_combination, lomustine soc_backbone. Thyroid hormone levels (T3/T4/TSH) measure the intended pharmacodynamic effect in blood, so target engagement = yes; they are not tumour molecular biomarkers, so no biomarker rows. 'Lomustine daily' wording in Category 1 conflicts with 6-weekly cycles; noted only.
